title: AiAdvice
description: One advisor use on a run (ai.advisor@1): the advice run it made, the model consulted, its effort, the tokens and the cost. The advice text itself is answered to the caller and not kept on the receipt.

run_id.description: The executor run the advice was asked for.

use.description: This use's number on the run, from 1.

advice_run_id.description: The run of workflow ai.chat that made the advice call; its own receipt carries the price.

model.description: The advisor model that answered, provider/model.

cost_usd.description: What this advice call cost, on the same price basis as the run's own cost.

words.description: How many words of advice came back.
